events.description: Ephemeral, typed events between the plugin's native and Shared Runtime parts. State stays in player.state; events never carry configuration.

name.description: Event name, unique within the plugin.

source.description: Which part raises the event. The other part receives it: a native source reaches the Shared Runtime part, and a runtime source reaches the native part.

player.description: Player contribution. Omit it for a plugin that has no Player behavior.

services.description: Server services (name@version) the plugin's typed Go client calls. The registry decides which a bundled plugin may declare.

settings.description: Host-owned settings. The organization scope holds one value for each field; the screen scope holds one for each field and screen.

kind.description: Identifier stored with every instance. It never changes.

path.description: URL segment below the plugin's API base path and Studio route, for example instances.

operations.description: Names of the generated operations: list<Plural>, get<Singular>, create<Singular>, update<Singular>, delete<Singular>.

targeting.description: screens: the host projects the instance to its target screens. none: the instance is never projected.

schedule.description: When the host projects the instance. A domain calendar stays plugin data.

priority.description: Gives each instance a priority. The host projects the strongest first.

connections.description: Host-owned outbound connections. Plugin code names a connection record and never states an origin, an address rule, or a credential.

id.description: Identifier that connection records and connection fields name. It never changes.

type.description: http: requests through http.fetch@1. oauth2: the same, with a host-run OAuth 2.0 authorization code flow and PKCE.

origins.description: A fixed list of canonical https origins (scheme, host, and port), or "operator": an Owner or Administrator enters one origin in Studio.

privateNetwork.description: allowed makes private addresses possible after a separate operator consent. Loopback and link-local addresses are never reached.

plainHttp.description: allowed makes an operator-entered http origin on private addresses possible after its own consent. Needs origins "operator" and privateNetwork "allowed".

allowPlaintextSecret.description: Lets a secret header travel over plain HTTP after a third consent. Needs plainHttp allowed.

maxResponseBytes.description: Response body bound. Default 1 MiB, at most 16 MiB. The install review shows a larger value.

timeoutSeconds.description: Time bound of one request, redirects and body included. Default 10 seconds.

oauth.description: The provider side of an oauth2 connection. The host runs the flow; plugin code never receives a token.

tokenRequestFormat.description: Token request body encoding. RFC 6749 uses form; some providers take JSON.

feeds.description: Datasets the plugin publishes with feeds.publish@1. Each appears as the Data Source provider <plugin id>.<feed id>.

version.description: The feed version. A schema change is a new version.

events.description: Server events the plugin publishes with events.publish@1, and the events it receives in HandleEvent.

version.description: The event version. A changed payload is a new version.

subscribes.description: Full event names: a core event such as incident.opened@1, or plugin.<plugin id>.<name>@<version>.

webhooks.description: Inbound endpoints the host owns at /api/v1/hooks/{pluginId}/{webhookId}. The plugin receives each accepted request in HandleWebhook.

id.description: The last segment of the endpoint /api/v1/hooks/{pluginId}/{webhookId}. It never changes.

authentication.description: token, signature, or fetch-back. The public mode needs moderation and is not part of this release.

ackStatus.description: The status of an accepted or repeated delivery, after the host queued it durably. Default 202.

handshake.description: An endpoint check the host answers itself.

secret.description: Key of the organization secret setting that holds the signing secret.

deliveryId.description: The provider's delivery ID: a header or a JSON Pointer into the body.
